Strike of employees on Tseng Tsong (正昌)
Glass Factory at 21/449 N. Shanse Road.

Sir,

At 9.30a.m. 25-8-40, one named Loo Kya Ping (陸嘉萍)
manager of Tseng Tsong Glass Factory at 21/449 N. Shanse
Road, made a report at station to the effect that the
factory staff had been on strike since 8a.m. 23-8-40.

As a result of enquiries made by D.S.I. Chu Man-
Wei and C.D.C.294, it was ascertained that the factory
employs 32 male workers and that their wages were divi-
ded into 5 classes i.e. $26, $20, $15, $16, $4.00 per
month.

On 10-8-40, a letter written by Lawyer Dan Zai
(陶然) representing the workers, was received by the
informant, in which demands for a general increase on
the following basis were made,

Wages under $10.00 per month - increase $□□
Wages under $20.00 per month - increase $□□
Wages above $20.00 per month - increase $□□

On 18-8-40, another letter written by the afore-
said lawyer was received which requested informant to
proceed to the Lawyer's Office at 58 Rue D' Chavallier,

北山西路21/449号正昌玻璃厂雇员罢工。

先生：

40年8月25日上午9时30分，北山西路21/449号正昌玻璃厂经理陆嘉萍（Loo Kya Ping）前往警局报案，称该厂职员自40年8月23日上午8时起一直罢工。

经副督察朱曼伟（Chu Man-Wei）及刑事侦缉队第294号警员调查后查明，该厂雇佣男工32名，其工资分为五等，即每月26元、20元、15元、16元、4.00元。

40年8月10日，报案人收到一封由代表工人的律师陶然（Dan Zai）所写的信件，信中要求按以下基础普遍增加工资：

月薪低于10.00元者 - 增加 $□□
月薪低于20.00元者 - 增加 $□□
月薪高于20.00元者 - 增加 $□□

40年8月18日，报案人又收到上述律师的另一封信，要求报案人前往法租界谢瓦利埃路（Rue D' Chavallier）58号律师事务所，以安排和平解决此事。因报案人未理会这两封信件，工人遂于40年8月23日罢工。

French Concession, to arrange an amicable settlement.
As these two letters were ignored by the informant,
the workers went to strike on 23-8-40.

Up to the time of submitting this report, no
untoward incident has occurred. Policemen patrolling
in the vicinity have, however, been warned to keep
a look out to prevent any damage to the factory pro-
perty.

Difficulty has been experienced in locating the
lawyer in order to obtain the names and address of the
workers' representatives, enquiries are, however, being
continued.

Efforts, if the employers are willing to negotiate,
will be made to arrange an amicable settlement and a
further report will be submitted in due course.

[签名]
Sen. Det. I/C. 26/8
D.D.C. "C" Div.

截至提交本报告时，尚未发生任何意外事件。然而，已在附近巡逻的警察受到警告，需保持警惕，以防工厂财产遭受任何破坏。

在寻找该律师以获取工人代表的姓名和地址方面遇到困难，但调查仍在继续。

如果雇主愿意谈判，将努力安排和平解决，并将在适当时候提交进一步报告。
